item.title: Psst
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: A non-partisan, non-profit public service that assists individuals in bringing forward public interest information while prioritizing safety and smart strategy. Psst provides full-service pro bono legal and media support for whistleblowers and anonymous sources. They emphasize collective action through the 'Psst Safe,' a secure vault for recording and vetting concerns. Currently, the Safe only accepts information related to the tech and artificial intelligence industries. Also offered: Mental health (Psychosocial) support — Psst can refer you to mental health experts with expertise in the issues faced by whistleblowers and others speaking out to provide needed support.

item.title: Whistleblowers of America
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Whistleblowers of America is a nonprofit organization assisting whistleblowers who have suffered retaliation after identifying harm to individuals or the public. It provides peer-to-peer support to overcome traumatic stress caused by retaliation, problem-solving assistance, and tools to document retaliation impacts. The organization also engages in legislative advocacy, training on retaliation prevention, and public education to foster environments where truth-telling is protected.

item.title: The Anti-Fraud Coalition
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The Anti-Fraud Coalition is a national nonprofit dedicated to empowering whistleblowers who expose fraud against the government and financial markets. Its official site prominently offers a whistleblower attorney directory and educational resources designed to help prospective whistleblowers find experienced counsel. The organization is narrower than a general whistleblower-support nonprofit because it centers anti-fraud, False Claims Act, and financial-market matters, but it remains highly practical for users whose concerns fit those areas. It is best viewed as a high-value referral hub rather than a general-purpose retaliation-support organization.
--- Nationwide scope note: The Anti-Fraud Coalition (TAF Coalition) is a public interest, non-profit organization dedicated to defending and empowering whistleblowers who expose fraud on the government and the financial markets.

Borderline entity: Attorney referral organization (TAF model). Preserved per addendum policy. [Gemini] Primary resource hub for reward-based qui tam and False Claims Act matters.

item.title: TIME'S UP Legal Defense Fund
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
TIME'S UP Legal Defense Fund is a nationwide legal-help and support pathway for people facing workplace sex harassment, sex discrimination, and related retaliation. The program is administered by the National Women's Law Center Fund and connects eligible users with attorneys through its intake process. It also provides funding for legal representation and media assistance in select workplace sex-harassment and retaliation matters. This makes it a strong fallback option for people who have already come forward and are now facing retaliation, as well as for people seeking counsel before escalating a report.
--- Nationwide scope note: "the only nationwide resource for people facing workplace sex harassment and retaliation to connect with legal help"
--- Researcher notes: [ChatGPT] Strong nationwide fit, but scope is limited to sex harassment, sex discrimination, and related retaliation rather than all whistleblower subject matters.

item.title: A Better Balance
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
A Better Balance is a national workers' rights nonprofit that offers a free, confidential legal helpline and online intake for workplace rights issues. Its help pathway covers workers nationwide dealing with leave rights, pregnancy discrimination, caregiving discrimination, accommodations, scheduling, and related retaliation risks. The organization provides direct assistance and legal guidance, and in some matters litigates or helps workers enforce their rights. It is a practical fallback resource for workers who need fast legal triage before or after making protected workplace complaints.
--- Nationwide scope note: "We assist workers nationwide"
--- Researcher notes: [ChatGPT] Useful fallback for retaliation-adjacent workplace disputes, especially around protected leave, pregnancy, caregiving, and accommodation issues; not a broad subject-matter whistleblower shop.

item.title: Center for WorkLife Law
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The Center for WorkLife Law is a national advocacy and research organization that also offers direct assistance through a free legal helpline. Its intake focuses on workplace and school issues related to pregnancy, lactation, family caregiving, leave, and related discrimination or retaliation. The organization states that it directly serves workers and students in all 50 states, D.C., and Puerto Rico, and its helpline is positioned as a practical support route for rights-enforcement questions. It is a solid fallback option for workers whose disclosure or complaint concerns caregiving, pregnancy, or accommodation issues and who fear or are experiencing retaliation.
